name: TC-SR-002 — 发起评审最小集校验 [P0]
description: 验证发起评审条件：至少5组达标、每组含原款图+模板图+首图+5张套图+构图/姿势/角度各3种
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const reviewBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('发起评审')); const statusText = document.body.textContent.match(/\d+\/\d+\s*组达标/)?.[0]; return { reviewBtnDisabled: reviewBtn?.disabled, statusText }; })()
steps.description: 检查发起评审按钮状态和达标提示

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const tips = []; if (text.includes('未达标')) tips.push('存在未达标图组'); if (text.includes('原款')) tips.push('提示原款图'); if (text.includes('套图')) tips.push('提示套图数量'); return { tips, textPreview: text.substring(0, 500) }; })()

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 检查发起评审按钮是否置灰
2. 检查达标组数提示
3. 检查未达标图组缺失项提示
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 未达5组时发起评审按钮置灰
2. 展示当前达标组数如'3/5 组达标'
3. 提示第一个未达标图组和缺失项
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
